goal: Prevent silent backup corruption and key loss by failing wallet dumps when disk writes fail
Ensure partial dump files are deleted and errors are returned when incomplete writes occur
agreement: Substantive support for fixing dump failure handling and ensuring crash durability (pablomartin4btc)
Earlier concern about crash resilience resolved by syncing writes and directories (sedited)

categories.name: wallet
why: P1 because silent failure during wallet dump risks permanent fund loss if users rely on truncated backups
Protects users from unknowingly relying on incomplete private key exports after I/O errors
